item.title: The Tokio/Rayon Trap and Why Async/Await Fails Concurrency
item.description:
📝 But beneath that familiar syntax lies massive structural complexity. The Production Trap: Confusing Asynchrony with Concurrency The fundamental trap of async/await is that it conflates asynchrony (yielding while waiting for I/O) with concurrency (dealing with multiple things at once). In-flight tasks queue indefinitely.
🔗 Read more: https://pmbanugo.me/blog/why-async-await-complect-concurrency
